full_prompt_en: A square digitally painterly floral image shows a dense gathering of pink, orange, red, and pale lavender blossoms against a cool lilac field. Large light pink daisy-like flowers with ocher centers rise near the middle and upper right of the selected panel, their petals defined by broad, soft strokes. To the left, orange and red blooms stand at different heights, with smaller pink clusters threading through gaps. Thin green stems and dark leafy marks connect the flowers vertically, while scattered bright petals and small buds extend toward the edges. The top third is comparatively open, filled with lavender-blue horizontal streaks and darker broken marks that resemble a smeared painted surface. Toward the lower half, pigment becomes much denser: green-black, crimson, orange, and white dashes overlap in a busy band, with several marks reflected or dragged sideways. A few pale blossoms remain visible near the lower center, though their outlines dissolve into the colored texture. The image offers no clear horizon or container; flowers and color fragments share the whole square. The viewpoint is close and roughly level with the blooms, allowing petals to appear large without a distant landscape. Light feels broad and even, making the pale petals and yellow centers bright while deep green shadows gather between stems. Sharp digital-looking streaks interrupt softer floral modeling, producing a layered, partially glitched texture. The overall composition is full and irregular, balancing recognizable flowers with horizontal color noise for a vivid, buoyant mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、具有数字绘画感的花卉画呈现粉、橙、红和浅薰衣草色花朵的密集聚集，背景是冷调淡紫色区域。所选单图中央和右上升起几朵大的浅粉色雏菊状花，花心赭黄，花瓣由宽而柔的笔触勾出。左侧橙花与红花高低错落，较小的粉色花簇穿过空隙。细绿茎与深色叶状笔痕把花朵竖向连起，零散亮色花瓣和小花蕾向边缘延伸。上部三分之一相对开阔，充满薰衣草蓝的水平拖痕和更暗的破碎笔迹，像被抹开的绘画表面。到下半部，颜色明显更密：绿黑、绯红、橙色与白色短划互相遮叠成忙碌的横带，数处笔痕被映出或向旁边拖开。下部中央仍能看出几朵浅色花，但轮廓逐渐融入彩色肌理。画面没有清楚地平线或容器；花朵与色彩碎片共享整个方框。视点贴近且大致与花齐平，花瓣显得很大，却没有远处风景。光宽泛均匀，使浅花瓣和黄色花心明亮，深绿阴影聚在茎之间。锐利、带数字质感的横向痕迹打断较柔和的花朵塑形，构成层叠、局部故障般的肌理。整体构图饱满而不规则，以可辨花朵平衡水平彩色杂点，形成鲜明轻快的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Digital painterly collage layers recognizable soft-edged forms with abrupt horizontal smears, fragmented blocks, and thin dark strokes. Cool lilac and blue fields are punctuated by saturated orange, crimson, pink, yellow, and leafy green. Pale rounded shapes remain readable near the focal center, while their lower edges dissolve into dense overlapping marks. Light is broad and even; emphasis comes from bright local color and dark gaps rather than cast shadows. Repeated upright stems counter the lateral dragging motion of the texture, creating a lively cross-directional rhythm. The surface alternates between translucent wash, thick opaque paint-like patches, and sharp digital interruptions. The overall effect is abundant, playful, and partly glitch-like without losing its painted warmth.
style_prompt_zh: 数字绘画式拼贴把边缘柔软、可辨认的形体与突兀的水平拖痕、碎色块和细深色线条层叠起来。冷淡紫与蓝色区域被饱和橙、绯红、粉、黄和叶绿刺破。浅色圆润形体在焦点附近仍可辨，下缘却融入密集遮叠笔痕。光宽泛均匀；重心来自明亮固有色与深色缝隙，而非投影。重复的直立细线对抗肌理的横向拖动，形成活跃的交叉方向节奏。表面在半透明晕染、厚重不透明的颜料状斑块和锐利数字干扰之间交替。整体效果繁盛、俏皮，局部像故障图像，却仍保留绘画的温度。
theme_en: A dense cluster of colorful flowers against a lilac field of horizontal smears
theme_zh: 多彩花簇密集生长在淡紫色横向拖痕背景前
name: Petra Cortright
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
